title: Grateful Dead Live at War Memorial on 1973-03-31
source: SBD > MC > CASS > DAT > CDA > DAW(Bertha) > Audio DVD > DVD Audio Extractor v.3.3.2 (audio files extracted prior to burning to DVD disc) > 24/48 wav > downsampled to 44.1 wav with Wave Lab v.5.00a > dithered to from 24-16 bit depth with Wave Lab UV22 HR Plugin > SBEs fixed with shntool v.2.0.3 (by set) > files rennamed with File Renamer v.1.0.0 > FLAC encoding with FLAC Frontend v.1.7.1 Etree Edition, FLAC v.1.1.2

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 3/31/73 show captured on a pristine soundboard tape, highlighted by a scorching He’s Gone → Truckin’ → The Other One → I Know You Rider sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently strong with an especially fire‑filled second set (He’s Gone, Truckin’, The Other One, Rider) and standout moments like Bertha, Greatest Story Ever Told, Box of Rain and a rare Sugar Magnolia finish.  The soundboard source sounds excellent – clear and well‑balanced despite some tape hiss that the archivist has cleaned up – making this a must‑listen for fans of early ’73.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive fan comments praise both the musical execution and the high‑quality soundboard capture; only minor technical quirks are noted, yielding a rating near the top of the scale.

recording_quality.technical_notes: A little tape hiss and bass EQ tweaking needed, but overall crystal‑clear balance; archivist’s cleanup work is praised as making it sound great.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual second‑set ordering (He’s Gone > Truckin' > The Other One > Rider) creates a rare and exciting flow; the first set is solid and upbeat, leading into a jam‑rich second half with standout transitions.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work is described as frenetic, full of Roy Buchanan‑style harmonics and an extra‑knowing conviction on songs like Tennessee Jed and the second‑set jams.
band_member_comments.Phil: Vocals on Box of Rain receive a special mention – Phil’s delivery isn’t climactic but blends beautifully with Donna Jean’s run.
